mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and a temperature of 82 degrees at Verona Community Park. The moon is a waning crescent, and tonight at 9:06 PM, you can spot the International Space Station as it passes from over Mount Horeb in the west southwest toward the northeast near Home Depot.

In city news, the Military Ridge State Trail will be closed starting September 14 through mid-November for bridge work, and the Plan Commission is meeting on October 5 to review new development projects.
It is a busy week in Verona. Today, enjoy the Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, Trivia Night at The Mill, or Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, make sure to catch Hop Haus Trivia.
The Verona Police Department reported that a teacher was arrested following an investigation into an incident that occurred on Sunday, August 30.
Culver's of Verona is serving up Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough today. They are currently open and will remain open until 10 PM.
